subject: Post-call recap: budget bands, blended pricing & adding a new model route
messages:
From: Claire Benson <claire@lumicorps.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumicorps.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — token profile and next steps

Thanks for the call earlier — helpful session. A couple quick clarifications from my side before we loop in procurement: 

- Our team expects steady-state generation of ~3.2M tokens/month today with bursts to ~8M for seasonal peaks.
- We budgeted $2,500–$5,000/month for inference (rough ceiling for hosted costs) but are flexible if we see strong efficiency gains.
- "Adding a new model route" means we want the current model for UGC summarization and to add a smaller embedding model for search vectors; will that require a separate route/charge?

Ask: can you provide a target $/1M token figure (hosted) for our baseline and for the blended rate if we add the second route? Also please include any step-up thresholds (volume bands) because procurement needs ranges.

Claire
Head of Product, Lumicorps

---
Attachment: usage-sample-1m-tokens.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Claire Benson <claire@lumicorps.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap and pricing sketch (baseline + route add)

Claire — great speaking with you. Recap + initial numbers below (high-level; formal proposal attached):

Recap of ask:
- Baseline: ~3.2M tokens/mo steady, peaks ~8M/mo
- Add: a second route for embeddings (smaller model) to run alongside current generation route
- Need: target $/1M tokens (hosted) for baseline and blended when both routes are active; volume-step bands for procurement sign-off

Initial pricing sketch (hosted API, USD):
- Baseline (generation-only): $1,900 per 1M tokens (monthly, pay-as-you-go) — this reflects model variant and sequence length profile discussed
- Embedding route: $300 per 1M tokens (embeddings priced separately by vector unit equivalence)
- Blended (illustrative): if you run both routes with the current mix (~3.2M gen + 0.8M embed = 4.0M total token-equivalent), blended comes to ~$1,600 / 1M tokens

Volume step-up discounts (monthly committed bands):
- 0–5M: list pricing above
- 5–20M: 10% off blended per-1M price
- 20M+: 22% off blended per-1M price + priority burst capacity

Example scenarios (monthly):
- Steady 3.2M gen + 0.8M embed = 4.0M => blended ~$1.6 / 1M => ~$6,400/mo
- Peak 8M gen + 2M embed = 10M => falls into 5–20M band => 10% off blended => effective ~$1,440 / 1M => ~$14,400/mo

Notes and assumptions:
- Blended is computed by token-equivalence (gen tokens counted at gen rate, embeddings priced by vector-equivalent). We'll provide the exact token-to-vector mapping in the formal doc.
- Hosted pricing assumes no reserved commitment; dedicated/reserved options lower unit cost further.
- We can define a custom route-mix for billing to match your internal meter if you prefer per-route invoicing rather than pure blended units.

Next steps:
1) I attached a short PDF with the sketch and a sample 3-month cost projection (redwood-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf).
2) If the initial bands look reasonable, procurement can request a formal quote and we can propose a 3–6 month trial with a 5% trial discount.
3) Internal: Aditya will model several route-mix scenarios and Ben will prepare a draft commercial term sheet if you want a commitment band.

I'll wait for procurement's target constraints and can iterate quickly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Irene.Choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0213

Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benson <claire@lumicorps.com>, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and pricing sketch (baseline + route add)

Claire — adding a short operational note from the infra side so procurement understands how route additions affect unit economics: 

- Adding a lightweight embedding route typically adds minimal incremental GPU time per inference if you co-locate the model on the same serving pool; cost moves closer to marginal storage and few-token compute rather than a full gen model footprint.
- If you want strict isolation (separate dedicated route/pool), that can increase base costs; we can give both options.

Suggested commercial setup given your volumes: start with hosted blended billing (simpler), track per-route consumption for reporting, then after 2–3 months evaluate if migrating the embedding route to dedicated (if it grows) would lower the blended unit cost.

Operational ask: Claire, can you share an example weekly peak day (EST) and expected average request latency requirement for the embedding queries? Even ballpark numbers help us size burst capacity.

Thanks — Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Benson <claire@lumicorps.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumicorps.com, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and pricing sketch (baseline + route add)

Thanks all — proposal looks promising and well-explained. Two quick follow-ups from procurement: 

1) Budget: procurement would like a conservative ceiling number they can sign off on for the initial 3-month trial. Can you provide a "worst-case 3-month" estimate that assumes a 2x above steady usage (i.e., treat 3.2M as 6.4M) and includes 10% buffer for extra API calls?
2) Billing: they prefer a single blended invoice line item for simplicity (procurement will accept a blended $/1M token metric) — please confirm you can supply monthly blended invoices and a per-route consumption report as CSV.

If we can get that conservative 3-month ceiling and a simple billing promise, procurement will circulate the trial PO next week.

Claire

---
Quoted: "Please include the 10% buffer in the conservative ceiling number."
